study type: paired pre-post study using data from two cross-sectional national surveys
exposure: change from fee-for-service (FFS) paid retrospectively to FFS paid prospectively
outcome: direct medical expenditures associated with deliveries
cohort: Pregnant women receiving care at health facilities in Burkina Faso
finding: The 2016 direct medical expenditures were higher than the 2014 expenditures, regardless of the type of delivery and level of care, except for dystocia and medical centres.
